name: fix-core-luck
about: The Luck stat (mods/core/scripts/HWP/Core/Luck.as, docs/design/luck.md): a custom stat hwp-luck from rolled gear (of Fortune affixes), the Rabbit's Foot trinket and timed buffs; Factor = 1 + luck/100 weights the rarer entries of drop rolls. In town as the host: `hwp luck 50` reads back in the status line and in the character sheet's Mods tab (widget hwp-luck); `hwp luck item 2` equips a chest piece with the rare affix (+10); `hwp luck buff 25 4000` is a timed buff that adds 25 and expires; `hwp luck roll` at 0 vs 500 Luck pays more epics / more hits / more tier-ups without spawning; a spawned strongbox and a spawned resource cache, used, log the opener's luck factor they rolled with ([HWP:strongbox] / [HWP:keys] luck x1.6 ... (opener <name>, Luck 60)) and the luck-rolled loot ([HWP:luck] loot ... factor 1.6). The character tab's stat bar shows the Luck cell (hwp-luck-stat, after movement speed).

steps.name: the strongbox rolled at its opener's Luck

steps.pattern: \[HWP:keys\] luck x1\.6 chest open loot \(opener .+, Luck 60\)
steps.name: the cache rolled at its opener's Luck
character tab shows the Luck cell
